long_biography.plain_text:
School holidays introduced Richard Beal to building sites long before he held an executive title. After leaving school, he joined Beal Homes full-time in 1988 and worked across the company before becoming managing director in 1996. He later succeeded his father John as chairman and acquired the founder's remaining shares, combining family succession with an operating career built from site work.

Under Beal's leadership, the East Yorkshire company has combined regional housebuilding with larger regeneration projects. Its Wykeland Beal partnership helped turn Hull's former wholesale Fruit Market into a mixed residential and commercial district, while Beal Homes expanded through developments across Yorkshire and Lincolnshire. A former three-season captain of Hull RUFC's first team, he has also tied the family company to long-running support of the club and regional charities.
